name: Candesartan
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

key_interactions.action: Contraindicated in diabetes; avoid if GFR below 60 mL/min.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: ACE inhibitors (dual RAS blockade); ACE inhibitor plus mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist
key_interactions.effect: More hypotension, hyperkalemia and kidney function changes; the triple combination is generally not recommended (label).
key_interactions.action: Avoid; if used, closely monitor blood pressure, kidney function and electrolytes.

key_interactions.drug_or_class: Potassium-sparing diuretics, potassium supplements, salt substitutes

key_interactions.effect: Worse kidney function, possible acute kidney failure in older, volume-depleted or CKD patients; weaker antihypertensive effect (label).
